body.description: Pumplet: a small oil pumpjack creature, the walking beam is its long neck with the horsehead as its head nodding up and down, counterweight body, a sturdy base for feet, slow patient nod, oily black and yellow. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
